issue_request: FHIR-37792 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested that the Narrative Linking example reference Composition.section.text rather than Composition.text, that originalText allow string or url values with fragment-id guidance for url values, and that narrativeLink/originalText wording explicitly identify DomainResource.text or Composition.section.text as allowable narrative targets.
initial_application: Core commit 33e68c1eda7168d4cc4282e3ced2a12256037b39 applied the Jira key by changing source/narrative.html so the cross-resource example places the referenced span under Composition.section.text. The current core checkout contains links/usages and OID mappings for originalText/narrativeLink, but no authoritative StructureDefinition source for those extensions.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2022-08-01 corroborate the Persuasive with Modification motion. The authoritative current narrativeLink and originalText StructureDefinitions are in the FHIR Extension Pack checkout, where originalText permits string and url, url usage includes fragment guidance, and both extension definitions mention DomainResource.text or Composition.section.text. Targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The in-scope core narrative example already implements the requested Composition.section.text target, and the remaining extension-definition requirements are already correct in the Extension Pack repository of record.
